decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building in particular and to satisfy the requirements of policies ENV B1.1New Development and H6.4 Extensions and alterations)

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Informative:  It is noted that the submitted drawings for this application show a full width roof extension, which the subsequent site visit has shown is not yet built. If the applicant is planning to build this after they receive approval for these extensions, they are advised to check whether this development can be built under permitted development rights, or would require planning permission.

Condition : 5 - The proposed extensions would be acceptable due to their position, design and appearance. The development would not harm the appearance of the area, or neighbours' living conditions and complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and  H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the The Adopted Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Erection of single storey rear and rear / side infill extension to house
